about: Shared expectations for decimal miles: 0.5/0.25/0.75 mi are a half / a quarter mile / three quarters of a mile, N.5/N.25/N.75 mi are 'N and a half/quarter/three quarters miles', other 0.x mi drop the leading zero ('point three miles'); 1.3 mi keeps 'one point three'; km and m untouched; numbers glued to something before them are left. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_distances.json). EpubToM4B can port the same rule; keep both copies in sync.
